message: I remember the last big storm we had, the kind that makes you wonder if it's time to build an ark. Instead of fretting, I decided to transform it into a cozy event. I set up a little fort in the living room with blankets and pillows, made hot cocoa, and we all huddled together with our favorite books. The wind howled outside, but inside, we were warm and snug, sharing stories and laughter. So, when the weather turns wild, how do you create a cozy vibe at home?
